author: Ahmed Seada
name: Craft editor plug-in
description: A plug-in for the Craft editor: a status item, a command with a key binding, a setting, and its plugin.json. Built against Craft.Abstractions alone.

craftPath.description: The Craft repository (absolute, or relative to the new project's folder): the project references its src/Craft.Abstractions. A build can still pass -p:CraftPath=FOLDER.

pluginName.description: The editor plug-in's short name: its commands' prefix (myplugin.hello) and its settings' variables (CRAFT_PLUGIN_MYPLUGIN_<KEY>).
